_comment: Suppressions for the ADVISORY dead-copy check in flow-xcheck.cjs. This check warns, it never blocks — an unsuppressed finding is a prompt to look, not an error. Suppress here only when the text genuinely renders from outside app source. Adding an entry to silence the warning is how this file rots: each one must carry a reason that would still be true six months from now.

schema.match: Normalized (lowercased, whitespace-collapsed) equality against the assertion's cleaned literal — not a regex.
schema.reason: Why the text can render without appearing in app/ or i18n/locales/en.

entries.reason: Android runtime-permission dialog radio option (location/notifications). Rendered by the OS, not by this app, so it can never appear in app source or the locale files.
Barikoi/Nominatim geocoder result asserted after typing a destination. The text comes from a third-party API response, not from app copy.
